SELECT COUNT(*) AS personDays, COUNT(DISTINCT s.employee_id) AS employeeCount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.stat_date) AS statDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS earlyDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'REST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS restDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.source = 'SAMPLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sampleDays, IFNULL(SUM(s.checkin_count), 0) AS checkinCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.work_minutes > 0 THEN s.work_minutes END)), 0) AS avgWorkMinutes FROM att_daily_stat s JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = s.employee_id
s.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo} AND e.dept_id = #{deptId} AND s.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT
CONCAT(YEAR(s.stat_date), '-W', LPAD(WEEK(s.stat_date, 1), 2, '0'))
DATE_FORMAT(s.stat_date, '%Y-%m')
s.stat_date
AS period, IFNULL(SUM(s.checkin_count), 0) AS checkinCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normalDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS earlyDays, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ABSENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absentDays, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.work_minutes > 0 THEN s.work_minutes END)), 0) AS avgWorkMinutes, -- 出勤率的分母排除休息日：周末没人打卡不是考勤问题 IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status IN ('NORMAL', 'LATE', 'EARLY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status <> 'REST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1), 0) AS attendanceRate, MAX(CASE WHEN s.source = 'SAMPLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample FROM att_daily_stat s JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = s.employee_id
s.stat_date BETWEEN #{query.dateFrom} AND #{query.dateTo} AND e.dept_id = #{query.deptId} AND s.employee_id = #{query.employeeId}
GROUP BY period ORDER BY period
